entities.summary:
Diego Guzmán de Haros was a cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church from 1629 to 1631.




A Spanish cleric, Guzmán de Haros held significant influence within the Church during a period of reform.




As cardinal, he played a crucial role in shaping the Church's response to the Protestant Reformation, using his position to promote ecumenical dialogue and cooperation between Catholics and Protestants.




Despite his efforts, Guzmán de Haros' tenure was cut short when he died on January 21, 1631, leaving behind a legacy of interfaith cooperation and a testament to the enduring power of the Catholic Church.
